name: billcraft
idea: BillCraft is a free, browser-only invoice generator that lets freelancers and small businesses create polished, professional PDF invoices in seconds — no signup, no watermark, no backend.
why_trending: The 'no login required, runs in browser' tool category is the #1 trend in 2026 (cited in April 2026 DEV.to roundup and trendnovaworld's best-free-tools ranking). Searches for 'free invoice generator no login' sustain millions of monthly visits to sites like invoice-generator.com, and freelance gig work continues growing globally.
why_profitable: Monetizes via display ads (high CPC freelance/finance keywords ~$2–6 CPM), optional premium tier for custom branding / bulk export, and affiliate links to accounting software (FreshBooks, QuickBooks, Wave). Comparable sites earn $5k–$50k/month at scale.
why_easy: 100% static HTML/CSS/JS — jsPDF handles PDF generation entirely client-side via CDN, no server, database, or auth layer needed. Can be hosted on GitHub Pages, Netlify, or any static CDN at zero cost.
